reviews.text: It’s really natural on the face. Not sticky. No smell. Love the colour. Downside is it doesn’t last long need to reapply. It’s small and good design easy to bring in the bag. Second time purchase.
reviews.zh: 上臉好自然。唔黐笠。冇味。好鍾意呢個顏色。缺點係唔持久，要補塗。細支，設計好，方便放落袋。第二次回購。

reviews.text: I love it! The shades are exactly as expected. The one on the left leaves a dewy finish, and on the right a more satin finish. Both great! It looks more pigmented on your cheeks and in the photo I attached
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！色號同預期完全一樣。左手邊嗰支做出水光妝效，右手邊嗰支就比較緞面妝效。兩支都好正！上面之後顯色度更高，我貼埋相上嚟。

reviews.text: Maybe I am using it wrong but both formulas look chalky and cakey on my skin and lips. It doesn’t matter how hydrated I am. It just kind of falls into the lines. Will keep trying but definitely have some other ones I prefer.
reviews.zh: 可能我用嘅方法唔啱，但兩支喺我塊面同嘴唇上都睇起嚟好粉好厚。唔理我有幾保濕都冇用。會卡入細紋。會繼續試吓，但肯定有其他我更鍾意嘅。

reviews.text: Amuse has some of the best products formulation, this looks so good together and blends so well for on the go, I like it so much, I bought an extra one. The fig balm color is more rosy, looks so natural, like your blushing within. I tried it on multiple girls for a dance recital, and they photographed so well, looking like little fairies!
reviews.zh: Amuse 嘅產品配方真係數一數二，呢兩支配埋一齊好靚，喺外面用好容易推開，我非常鍾意，所以額外多買咗一支。Fig balm 嗰支顏色偏玫瑰色，好自然，好似由內散發出嚟嘅紅暈。我幫幾個女仔表演舞蹈時用，影相出嚟效果好正，好似小仙女！

reviews.text: didnt see much pigment, though I'm not the palest but i'm not tan. also, avoid dropping this as much as possible, the packaging on mine is already split from having fallen from my pocket, and i received it yesterday.
reviews.zh: 顯色度唔算高，雖然我唔算最白但都唔黐黑。另外，盡量唔好跌，我自己嗰支跌咗一次跌出褲袋就已經裂開，我琴日先收到。

reviews.text: Literally my favorite product ever right now, I am slowly collecting all the colors!! It's the perfect product for a natural glowy glass skin look, I also use it on my eyes for a wash of color for monochrome look. Honestly I don't use it a lot of the lips because the shades can look too pale, but the darker shade in grape balm is beautiful on my naturally darker lips.
reviews.zh: 依家絕對係我最鍾意嘅產品，我慢慢儲齊所有色號！！佢係打造自然水光玻璃肌嘅完美產品，我仲會用佢做眼影嚟做單色妝感。講真我唔算多用喺嘴唇，因為色號會顯得太淡，但 grape balm 嗰支深色喺我天生偏深嘅唇上面好靚。

reviews.text: This won’t last long after applying it. You can barely see the color/tint of the balm. It gives a shiny look when you apply it on the cheek but not a tint. I hate that i need to use mu finger to apply it.
reviews.zh: 搽完之後唔襟用。幾乎睇唔到 balm 嘅顏色或色調。搽上面係有光澤但冇任何色調。要用手指嚟搽真係好煩。

reviews.text: I'm so sad that I hate this because my girl Wonyoung stared into my eyes and convinced me to buy it but it's trash. Color does not show up on the skin unless u pile it on and it still won't look good. So sad.
reviews.zh: 好難過我竟然要嬲呢樣嘢，因為我女神 Wonyoung 用眼神望住我氹我買，點知係垃圾。除非你厚厚疊上去，否則顏色根本睇唔到，疊咗都唔會好睇。好sad。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
